# Message Queue

## Summary
A composer that stays usable while the agent is working. Enter still sends right away, but ⌘Enter (Ctrl+Enter elsewhere) parks the message in a queue stacked above the input. Each queued message can be sent now, pulled back to edit, or removed — and when the current turn finishes, the oldest one goes out automatically. Users keep thinking ahead instead of waiting for the agent to finish.

## When to use
- Agentic products where turns run for seconds or minutes (coding agents, research, multi-step tool use) and users already know their next instruction.
- When interrupting the running turn is costly or risky, so "send it after this" needs to be a distinct, safer choice than "send it now".

## When not to use
- Fast, single-shot chat where responses land in a second or two — the queue would never be visible long enough to matter.
- When the next message depends on reading the current answer first; a queue only helps when the follow-up is already known.
- Products that can't actually defer a message — never show a queue the backend won't honor in order.

## Anatomy
- Composer: input, send button (morphs to Stop while busy and empty), and a "Queue ⌘↵" button that appears while busy and there's a draft.
- Placeholder hint while busy: "↵ to send, ⌘↵ to queue" — teaches the shortcut exactly when it applies.
- Queue stack: one muted row per queued message, above the composer, oldest first. The first row carries the count ("2 queued"); each row shows a truncated preview.
- Row actions: Send now (return arrow), Edit (pencil), Remove (×).

## Behavior
- Idle: Enter sends; ⌘Enter behaves like Enter (there's nothing to queue behind).
- Busy: Enter sends immediately — the host decides whether that steers or interrupts the current turn. ⌘Enter appends the draft to the queue and clears the input.
- When a turn ends, the oldest queued message is sent automatically and marked as coming from the queue; the rest wait for the next turn to finish. Stopping the turn also releases the queue.
- Send now removes the row and sends it immediately, skipping the line.
- Edit pulls the message back into the composer for changes. If the user had an unsent draft, the draft takes the edited message's slot so nothing typed is lost.
- ↑ on an empty composer recalls the last queued message for editing, mirroring shell history.
- Rows slide in from the composer when queued and lift away when sent or removed; the stack reflows with layout animation.

## Content guidelines
- Name the state plainly: "Queued", "2 queued". Avoid "pending", which reads like a sending failure.
- Show the shortcut as glyphs (⌘↵, Ctrl↵) matched to the user's platform, never both.
- Previews are one line, truncated; the full text is available on hover and via Edit.

## Accessibility
- The queue is a list labeled "Queued messages"; every row action is a real button with an `aria-label` and a tooltip.
- A polite live region announces the queue count when it changes, so screen-reader users know a message was parked rather than sent.
- The input exposes its shortcuts via `aria-keyshortcuts`, and the visible "Queue" button gives pointer and touch users the same action without the chord.
- Edit and Remove return focus to the composer.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: rows fade instead of sliding and reflowing.

## Related patterns
- **Stop Generation Button** — Use it as well as the send/stop control the composer shows while the agent is busy.
- **Prompt Bar** — Use it instead when the agent can't be busy between messages and there is nothing to queue.
- **Task List** — Use it as well when the agent has its own plan, so the plan shows its steps and the queue holds the user's next instructions.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { ArrowUp, CornerDownLeft, Pencil, Square, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface QueuedMessage {
  id: string;
  text: string;
}

export type SendMode = "now" | "queued";

export interface MessageQueueComposerProps {
  /** True while the agent is working on a turn. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter queues only while busy. */
  busy: boolean;
  /**
   * Called when a message goes out. `"now"` is a message sent directly (Enter, or
   * "Send now" on a queued item — the host decides whether that steers or interrupts
   * the running turn); `"queued"` is a queued message auto-sent when the turn ended.
   */
  onSend: (text: string, mode: SendMode) => void;
  onStop?: () => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  className?: string;
}

const spring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 520, damping: 40 } as const;

let uid = 0;
const nextId = () => `q${++uid}`;

const noop = () => () => {};

function useIsMac() {
  return React.useSyncExternalStore(
    noop,
    () => /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent),
    () => true
  );
}

export function MessageQueueComposer({
  busy,
  onSend,
  onStop,
  placeholder = "Ask anything",
  className,
}: MessageQueueComposerProps) {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState("");
  const [queue, setQueue] = React.useState<QueuedMessage[]>([]);
  const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const mac = useIsMac();
  const mod = mac ? "⌘" : "Ctrl";

  // When the running turn ends, the oldest queued message goes out on its own.
  const wasBusy = React.useRef(busy);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (wasBusy.current && !busy && queue.length > 0) {
      const [next, ...rest] = queue;
      setQueue(rest);
      onSend(next.text, "queued");
    }
    wasBusy.current = busy;
  }, [busy, queue, onSend]);

  function focusInput() {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const el = inputRef.current;
      if (!el) return;
      el.focus();
      el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length);
    });
  }

  function submit(toQueue: boolean) {
    const text = value.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    setValue("");
    if (toQueue && busy) setQueue((q) => [...q, { id: nextId(), text }]);
    else onSend(text, "now");
  }

  function sendNow(item: QueuedMessage) {
    setQueue((q) => q.filter((m) => m.id !== item.id));
    onSend(item.text, "now");
  }

  function edit(item: QueuedMessage) {
    const draft = value.trim();
    // Pull the message back into the composer; an unsent draft takes its slot so nothing is lost.
    setQueue((q) => q.flatMap((m) => (m.id !== item.id ? [m] : draft ? [{ id: nextId(), text: draft }] : [])));
    setValue(item.text);
    focusInput();
  }

  function remove(item: QueuedMessage) {
    setQueue((q) => q.filter((m) => m.id !== item.id));
    focusInput();
  }

  function onKeyDown(e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
      e.preventDefault();
      submit(e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp" && !value && queue.length > 0) {
      // Up on an empty composer recalls the last queued message for editing.
      e.preventDefault();
      edit(queue[queue.length - 1]);
    }
  }

  const hint = busy ? `↵ to send, ${mod}↵ to queue` : placeholder;

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full", className)}>
      <ul aria-label="Queued messages" className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 empty:hidden">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {queue.map((item, i) => (
            <motion.li
              key={item.id}
              layout={!reduceMotion}
              initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.97 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
              exit={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: -6, scale: 0.97, transition: { duration: 0.15 } }}
              transition={spring}
              className="mx-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-muted py-1.5 pr-1.5 pl-3 text-sm last:mb-1.5"
            >
              <span className="shrink-0 font-medium text-foreground">
                {i === 0 ? (queue.length === 1 ? "1 queued" : `${queue.length} queued`) : `#${i + 1}`}
              </span>
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-muted-foreground" title={item.text}>
                {item.text}
              </span>
              <QueueAction label="Send now" onClick={() => sendNow(item)}>
                <CornerDownLeft className="size-3.5" />
              </QueueAction>
              <QueueAction label="Edit" onClick={() => edit(item)}>
                <Pencil className="size-3.5" />
              </QueueAction>
              <QueueAction label="Remove from queue" onClick={() => remove(item)}>
                <X className="size-3.5" />
              </QueueAction>
            </motion.li>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </ul>

      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          submit(false);
        }}
        className="flex items-end gap-2 rounded-2xl border bg-card p-2 pl-3.5 shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-ring/30"
      >
        <textarea
          ref={inputRef}
          rows={1}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          placeholder={hint}
          aria-label="Message"
          aria-keyshortcuts={busy ? `Enter ${mac ? "Meta" : "Control"}+Enter` : "Enter"}
          className="max-h-32 min-h-8 flex-1 resize-none bg-transparent py-1.5 text-sm outline-none [field-sizing:content] placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
        />
        {busy && value.trim() && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => submit(true)}
            className="flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
          >
            Queue
            <kbd className="font-sans text-[10px]">{mod}↵</kbd>
          </button>
        )}
        <motion.button
          type={busy && !value.trim() ? "button" : "submit"}
          onClick={busy && !value.trim() ? onStop : undefined}
          disabled={!busy && !value.trim()}
          aria-label={busy && !value.trim() ? "Stop" : "Send"}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.92 }}
          className="flex size-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-foreground text-background transition-colors disabled:bg-muted disabled:text-muted-foreground"
        >
          {busy && !value.trim() ? <Square className="size-3 fill-current" /> : <ArrowUp className="size-4" />}
        </motion.button>
      </form>
      <p aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {queue.length > 0 ? `${queue.length} message${queue.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} queued` : ""}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

function QueueAction({
  label,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      className="flex size-7 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-background hover:text-foreground focus-visible:bg-background focus-visible:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none"
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```
